summary: Workspace materialization collision handling was host-POSIX dependent for Windows case-insensitive paths
resolution: NFC-normalized case-folded relative-path collision keys plus deterministic POSIX/Windows grammar tests
acceptance: Cross-platform path contract is explicit and focused tests pass on POSIX and native Windows

summary: Runtime provenance parsed Windows-style executable paths with POSIX semantics
resolution: Portable executable basename extraction using Windows grammar support plus drive/UNC/slash/backslash tests
acceptance: Drive-letter, UNC, slash, and backslash executable forms produce stable names in focused and native Windows tests

summary: Cancellation-policy artifact validation did not reject Windows drive-letter absolute paths on POSIX and initially accepted unsafe NUL/ancestor-symlink forms
resolution: Independent POSIX/Windows absolute, drive, root, traversal, redaction, NUL, final-symlink, and symlink-ancestor checks; root and independent verifier focused suites pass 20 tests each
acceptance: Path, hash, byte, traversal, and symlink policies are independently tested across path grammars

summary: Paper inventory generator output and dependent sidecars/tests disagreed on section scope and counts
resolution: Authoritative Section 5 records regenerated six sidecars and added exact freshness tests; expanded boundary/freshness slice passes 50 tests and an independent verifier confirmed exact source/sidecar counts
acceptance: One authoritative source regenerates all dependent artifacts and stale-artifact consistency tests pass

summary: Prior full-suite run exposed ablation, cached-PDF, benchmark-hardening, and matrix-result failures
resolution: Targeted remediation slice passed 165 tests; cached-PDF extraction was bounded to pypdf>=6.6,<6.11; complete logged gate remains pending
acceptance: Each failure is reproduced, independently diagnosed, fixed or explicitly classified, and covered by a passing gate

summary: core/loop.py combines orchestration, state, persistence, reporting, and policy at exceptional size
acceptance: Measured cohesion/coupling baseline and incremental seam extraction preserve public behavior with characterization tests

summary: Hundreds of active TODOs and boundary sidecars require deduplication and evidence-aware ownership
acceptance: TODO/sidecar inventory has owners, dependencies, evidence states, and no mechanical closure

summary: Additional maintainability defects may exist in imports, global state, errors, portability, cleanup, determinism, serialization, API drift, and documentation
acceptance: All module reports include an explicit audit of these dimensions and unresolved findings are recorded

summary: A naive static import graph reported a large multi-package cycle spanning core, llm, population, and plugins
resolution: Module-level import graph has zero SCCs; lazy function-local imports are intentional; a fresh process imported all 15 affected modules successfully
acceptance: Cycle is independently confirmed or explained as a false positive; confirmed cycles are removed or isolated behind stable dependency seams with import tests

summary: A naive static import graph reported a benchmark_hardening/example_scope cycle
resolution: The cross-edge is a function-local lazy import; module-level graph has zero SCCs and both modules imported successfully
acceptance: Cycle is independently confirmed or explained, and benchmark package imports remain acyclic or intentionally lazy with a documented contract

summary: Complexity baseline shows core/loop.py at 49,605 lines, paper_manifest.py at 15,430, prompt.py at 11,952, database.py at 11,841, and multiple functions over 500 lines
acceptance: Owners define measured seam/refactor targets, preserve public contracts with characterization tests, and record before/after complexity rather than relying on file movement

summary: Direct evaluator preflight did not forward top-level declared evaluator data policy
resolution: Forwarded evaluator include/exclude declarations and added import-time regression coverage
acceptance: Direct and contract-preflight paths enforce declared evaluator data policy

summary: Benchmark artifact validators duplicated path checks and missed some Windows grammar cases
resolution: Added shared safe-relative-path policy and applied it to ablation, hardening, and matrix artifacts
acceptance: All affected validators reject absolute, drive, traversal, NUL, and unsafe symlink paths under both grammars

summary: Cached-PDF header evidence depended on an unbounded pypdf lower bound
resolution: Pinned the supported extraction range to pypdf>=6.6,<6.11 and documented the deviation
acceptance: Cached-PDF extraction is stable within the documented dependency policy

summary: Integrated fixes lack completed independent verifier results because nested delegation was stopped for shared-checkout safety
acceptance: A non-authoring verifier reviews each integrated patch, reruns focused tests, and records an independent result

summary: Repeated local wheel/sdist builds were not byte-identical
acceptance: Build reproducibility policy is explicit and repeated builds are deterministic or differences are bounded and explained

summary: Current /papers/* ignore behavior can hide newly generated boundary sidecars
acceptance: Tracked/generated paper artifacts have an explicit allowlist or freshness gate that cannot silently disappear

summary: Version literals and lower-bounded dependencies lack a single canonical consistency or replay policy
acceptance: Version ownership and lower-bound versus lock/constraints policy are documented and checked

summary: No verified coordinator-to-MCP-to-gateway-to-mod-to-effect-witness end-to-end runtime trace exists
acceptance: A repeatable authorized end-to-end fixture records each boundary and artifact witness, or the gap is explicitly accepted as out of scope
